commits.subject: tests: define NO_UI in the command line FPC build scripts
commits.body:
Since fe0b21d2a, HAS_UI/HAS_UI_LCL/HAS_UI_VCL_LCL are defined for every FPC
target, so HAS_UI_PDF is set on Windows even without a Lazarus LCL around.
mormot2tests.dpr then needs the LCL "Interfaces" unit and test.ui.pdf, which
are not in a command line build's unit path:

  mormot2tests.dpr(73,3) Fatal: (10022) Can't find unit Interfaces used by
  mormot2tests

NO_UI is documented as the project level opt-out for exactly this ("disable
whole UI path e.g. in mormot2tests"), so use it where there is no widgetset:
build_winarm.bat, and build_fpc.sh for its win* targets only - a POSIX target
has no HAS_UI_PDF anyway. Lazarus builds are unaffected: mormot2tests.lpi and
packages/lazarus/mormot2ui.lpk require the LCL packages and keep the UI path.

Verified on aarch64-win64: mormot2tests now builds again and passes.
commits.author: Sven Harazim

-  CONDITIONALS="$CONDITIONALS -CX -XX"
+  # no LCL widgetset in a command line build, so no HAS_UI_PDF/test.ui.pdf
+  CONDITIONALS="$CONDITIONALS -CX -XX -dNO_UI"
 fi

   CONDITIONALS="$CONDITIONALS -CX -XX"
